en.prompt: Build an opening called Prompt Carousel. Pure white background; a centered four-word title ("What should we build?", 64px) rises 19px and fades in, staggered 0.09s per word with expo.out over 0.4s. A thin black line spreads outward from the text's midline to 860px over 0.2s, thickens over 0.3s into a 112px black pill, and the text turns white on the same frame. The pill then widens to 1280px over 0.4s with power3.inOut while the headline shrinks to 30px into the text slot, and an attach button, a model selector and a send button fade in around it. After the headline clears, type the first prompt at about 15 characters per second with a cursor following the last character, with the next prompt visible in 22% gray below the box. Then the whole column scrolls up one 90px row with a 0.3 second expo.out, 0.4s after typing and again every 0.85s, three times, with the old row turning light gray above the pill. Finally press send (scale 0.88, then back.out(1.7)), fade the shell, and close the pill to 480×124px around your mark and wordmark. A slow scale push of 1 to 1.05 runs through the whole piece.
says: The title turns into an input box that types prompts one by one
The prompts in the input box scroll up to the next one
vs: Rhythmic Typing is a single line typed and deleted in the center of the screen; Prompt Carousel's container is an input box with several prompts scrolling vertically.
Word-by-Word Highlight only brightens text and involves no change in input box form.

en.title: Prompt Carousel: AI Input Box Animation Recipe
en.description: A line under a headline thickens into a pill, becomes an input box and types prompts that scroll. Make it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
en.lede: A line under the headline thickens into a pill, becomes an input box, and types a list of prompts that scroll vertically.
en.name: Prompt Carousel

body.h2: How to make a Prompt Carousel with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Raise the four-word headline (64 px, weight 600) from y 19 to 0 with a 0.09 s stagger. A 3 px line spreads to 860 px, then thickens into a 112 px pill (radius 56) at 1.0 to 1.3 s. It widens to 1280 px at 1.4 to 1.8 s with power3.inOut while the headline shrinks to 30 px into the text slot.

Type the first prompt at about 15 characters per second (41 characters, 2.15 to 4.87 s). The column then scrolls up 90 px per row at 5.27, 6.12 and 6.97 s, each 0.3 s with cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). Rows above turn rgba(17,17,17,0.22) and the next prompt shows at 22% opacity below. The send press at 7.82 s scales to 0.88.

Press the copy button on the recipe page and paste it into Claude Code or Codex, or run npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent renders an MP4 with HyperFrames, or ports the GSAP timeline to your site with your own headline and prompts.

en.alt: An AI prompt box reading "A pricing page with monthly/annual toggle" with the next suggestions faded below.
faq: A prompt carousel is an input box that cycles through example prompts: it types one, then scrolls vertically to the next. It shows what a product can be asked and keeps all motion on one vertical axis.
How do I build the scrolling prompt list?

Keep the prompts in one column and translate it up by one row height per step, 90 px here, with GSAP. Set the incoming row's text to white on the same frame the column moves, and show the rows above and below at 22% opacity.
Is the Prompt Carousel recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

zh.title: 输入框提示词轮播：示例与制作配方
zh.description: 标题下的一条线加厚成胶囊，再变成输入框，框内逐条打出提示词并上下滚动。用免费配方，让 Claude Code 或 Codex 做出这段动画。
zh.lede: 标题下一条线加厚成胶囊再变输入框，框内逐条打提示词并上下滚动。
zh.name: 输入框提示词轮播

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做输入框提示词轮播
body.body:
四个词的标题（64px，字重 600）按 0.09 秒错开，从 y 19 升到 0。一条 3px 的线展开到 860px，1.0 到 1.3 秒加厚成 112px 的胶囊（圆角 56px），1.4 到 1.8 秒用 power3.inOut 拉宽到 1280px，标题同时缩到 30px 并落进文字槽。

第一条提示词以约每秒 15 个字符打出（41 个字符，2.15 到 4.87 秒）。随后整列在 5.27、6.12、6.97 秒各向上滚动一行，每行 90px，历时 0.3 秒，缓动 cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)。上面的行变成 rgba(17,17,17,0.22)，下一条提示词以 22% 不透明度露出。7.82 秒的发送按压缩放到 0.88。

在配方页点复制按钮，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以运行 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。智能体会用 HyperFrames 渲染 MP4，或者把 GSAP 时间线移植到你的网站，标题和提示词换成你自己的。

zh.alt: AI 输入框写着带月付年付切换的定价页，下方淡出下一条建议。
faq: 指一个输入框循环展示示例提示词：先打出一条，再垂直滚动到下一条。它让人看到产品可以问些什么，所有运动都在同一条竖直轴上。
怎样做提示词上下滚动？
把提示词放进一列，每一步用 GSAP 把整列上移一行的高度，这里是 90px。新进入行的文字在整列移动的同一帧变白，上下相邻的行以 22% 不透明度显示。
提示词轮播配方可以免费使用吗？
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
